meta.title: Quick translate
meta.description: Open Quick translate from the left sidebar to get a paper-collage desk: paste text on the grid notebook on the left, press ⌘/Ctrl+Enter (or the red Translate tape), and read the streaming translation on the tracing paper on the right. The kraft tag in the corner picks EN→ZH, ZH→EN, or Auto. The Model line at the bottom of the tracing paper lists every provider and model already configured in DSH under Settings › Models and follows the DSH default until you choose one. The Swap tab between the two sheets swaps source and translation and flips the direction; click again to swap back. Finished translations land on the History receipt, where you can search, reopen, or delete them; Share image renders the current pair as a card you can copy or save as PNG. The Style switch in the header toggles between this paper desk and a plain Field layout that follows the DSH light/dark theme; both have the same features. Each request goes to the selected model's provider, so the text is sent to that service; Esc cancels. History stays in this browser only; turning the plugin off removes the entry and touches no Session.
